title: A not-charged-off loan's penalty chargeback credits FUND_SOURCE 280.00, debits LOAN_PORTFOLIO 250.00, then debits PENALTIES_RECEIVABLE 30.00 (loan 12 L82)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the not-charged-off journal entry a loan CHARGEBACK posted, the penalty shape, on the Tier-D Part2 MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_DOWNPAYMENT_ADV_PMT_ALLOC_PROG_SCHEDULE_HOR_INST_LVL_DELINQUENCY_CREDIT_ALLOCATION). request.chargeback_journal.amount is the accepted chargeback request transactionAmount 280.0 -> "28000" minor units, raised with paymentTypeId 2 (loans/loan-12/loan-12-chargeback-request.json); transaction_id L82 is the sweep's transactionId for the read-back's transaction id 82 (type Chargeback). request.chargeback_journal.portions transcribes the read-back's chargeback transaction id 82: principalPortion 250.0 -> "25000", feeChargesPortion 0.0 -> "0", penaltyChargesPortion 30.0 -> "3000", overpaymentPortion 0.0 -> "0"; the observed identity amount = principal + fee + penalty + overpayment holds (28000 = 25000 + 0 + 3000 + 0). request.chargeback_journal.charged_off is the read-back's top-level chargedOff false (fraud false); when charged off getPrincipalAccount / getFeeAccount / getPenaltyAccount resolve CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE / INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_FEES / INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_PENALTY. request.chargeback_journal.accounts transcribes the product mapping LP2_DOWNPAYMENT_ADV_PMT_ALLOC_PROG_SCHEDULE_HOR_INST_LVL_DELINQUENCY_CREDIT_ALLOCATION: fundSourceAccountId 6, loanPortfolioAccountId 5, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 17, receivableFee/PenaltyAccountId 10, chargeOffExpenseAccountId 16, incomeFromChargeOffFees/PenaltyAccountId 14; paymentTypeId 2 has no channel mapping (the one channel mapping is paymentTypeId 1 -> 19), so the default FUND_SOURCE 6 applies, exactly the account the observed credit names. expect.chargeback_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the 3 L82 legs in id order: JE 179 CREDIT account 6 280.0, JE 180 DEBIT account 5 250.0, JE 181 DEBIT account 10 30.0. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: on a NOT charged-off loan the principal debit is LOAN_PORTFOLIO 5 and the penalty debit PENALTIES_RECEIVABLE 10, the ordinary receivable branch the charged-off switch must not apply here. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every amount, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
